BETA Close X Mears Group PLC has executed its share buyback program by purchasing a total of 379,097 ordinary shares between June 22, 2026, and June 26, 2026, with prices ranging from 391.00 pence to 404.89 pence per share. These repurchased shares are slated for cancellation, contributing to the 2,871,031 shares bought back and cancelled since the program's inception on April 1, 2026. Disclaimer* Mears Group PLC 29 June 2026 29 June 2026 Mears Group PLC Transaction in Own Shares Mears Group PLC ('Mears' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme announced on 1 April 2026 (the 'Buyback Programme'), the Group has purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 penny each (the 'Ordinary Shares') through Panmure Liberum Limited in the period from 22 June 2026 to 26 June 2026. Date of Purchase Number of ordinary shares purchased Weighted average price per day (pence) Highest price per share (pence) Lowest price per share (pence) 22 June 2026 42,815 397.30 400.00 394.00 23 June 2026 69,532 393.50 395.00 391.00 24 June 2026 54,893 397.22 400.00 394.00 25 June 2026 49,684 404.89 405.50 402.00 26 June 2026 73,218 402.79 405.00 400.50 The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Buyback Programme on 1 April 2026, Mears has purchased 2,871,031 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation.
